policies.sentence: Students must not use AI during exams or quizzes.
Students must take exams closed-book and unaided, using only allowed materials and no devices or outside resources.
Students will have no access to AI tools or the internet during assessments, which are on paper.
Exams and in-class assessments are meant to test students' own knowledge and understanding.
Students must attest that quizzes are completed without AI assistance.
Students must not use AI during class, discussion sections or sessions unless the instructor permits.
